purpose: record every publication channel, the commit read back from the remote, and the byte-level verification an external acceptor can repeat

clock_semantics.note: local wall clock (+08:00) and UTC are recorded as separate fields; neither is used as a commit-ordering oracle. The authoritative commit time is git's committer time, taken from the commit itself in the post-commit readback.
clock_semantics.superseded_defect: version /1 carried generated_utc=2026-10-15T20:20Z, which post-dated the commit it described (real committer time 2026-10-15T11:33:13Z). EIA-R6-02.

channels.head_after_repair: BOUND_BY_POST_COMMIT_READBACK (this file deliberately does not name the sha of the commit that contains it; see R6R7_POST_COMMIT_READBACK.json and the PR #3 comment, both held outside the commit)

channels.status: unchanged by this round: the R6R7 repair is scoped to the Fabric PR #3 branch only

byte_level_verification.method: for every blob under the packet path in the remote git tree, recompute git's blob id sha1('blob <len>\\0' + bytes) from the source-of-truth file and compare with the remote entry
byte_level_verification.result_for_current_head: recomputed in R6R7_POST_COMMIT_READBACK.json after the repair commit; that file is outside the commit so its numbers cannot go stale the way the 566/566 claim did
byte_level_verification.why_this_matters: PACKET_MANIFEST.json lists a sha256 per file; if blobs are EOL-normalized on the way into git, an external acceptor downloading a file and recomputing sha256 sees a spurious mismatch

defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.what: the repositories' text normalization (core.autocrlf=true + text attributes) rewrote CRLF to LF in the committed blobs: 328 packet files were published with converted content, so their sha256 did not match PACKET_MANIFEST.json
defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.how_found: by recomputing git blob ids for spot-checked files against the remote API, seeing MISMATCH, then fetching the remote blob bytes and confirming the difference was exactly CRLF->LF
defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.fix: EVIDENCE/CNV-PIPD-LS-SP-20261015/.gitattributes with '* -text' in the packet subtree + core.autocrlf=false repo-local + 'git add --renormalize' + a follow-up commit
defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.verification_after_fix: full blob comparison on the affected branch: 0 mismatches

defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.what: the first PIPD-LS-SP publication attempt committed nothing: git refused with 'empty ident name not allowed', yet the push still created the branch and the readback printed MATCH True
defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.how_found: reading the commit output instead of trusting the exit path
defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.fix: repo-local user.name/user.email on that clone, then commit + push + a real content check
defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.lesson_recorded: a ref-level MATCH proves only ref equality; it is never content evidence — verify the tree, not the ref

defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.what: PACKET_MANIFEST.json /1 listed 569 rows including two gitignored __pycache__/*.pyc that git never carried, so the packet's implied '569/569 published' was false; PACKET_MANIFEST.json /2 now separates tracked_inventory from local_only_excluded
defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.how_found: external independent review (EIA-R6-01) by set comparison of the PR tree against the manifest rows
defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.fix: manifest schema /2 + explicit publish_claim + local_only_excluded rows with reason and check-ignore rule
defects_found_and_fixed_during_publicati.verification_after_fix: set equality between tracked_inventory and the remote tree at the post-commit head (R6R7_POST_COMMIT_READBACK.json)

what_an_external_acceptor_can_check: API/ls-remote: PR #3 branch head equals the head in R6R7_POST_COMMIT_READBACK.json
download PACKET_MANIFEST.json and recompute sha256 for every path in tracked_inventory; the count must equal the git tree's blob count under the prefix
confirm local_inventory_count - tracked_file_count == len(local_only_excluded) == 2 and that neither .pyc path is in the git tree, nor indexed
read R6R7_ARCHIVE_ERRATA.json for what this round corrected and what was deliberately left untouched
read M2_TRUSTED_SCOPE_SECRETS.json for the scope/secret scan (tool version, scanned blob count, scan digest, hard/soft findings)
read EIA_R6_FINDINGS_DISPOSITION.json for EIA-R6-01..09 disposition and R7_BLOCKERS_AND_TASKS.json for what is still open
note the claim ceiling: candidate-only, LOCAL; no acceptance, no approval, no production effect is claimed
claim_ceiling: LOCAL / candidate-only. Publication facts plus integrity and hygiene checks performed by the mission itself; they are NOT independent acceptance and close no acceptance case.
